evidence: Modifies `MemPoolAccept::AcceptPackage()` in `src/validation.cpp` to adjust package acceptance, eviction handling, and reject reasons.
rationale: Package transactions evicted immediately upon acceptance due to `LimitMempoolSize()` return `TX_MEMPOOL_POLICY` instead of `TX_RECONSIDERABLE`, causing peer reject filters to reject subsequent higher-fee bumps until the next block. As the author notes, this bug was discovered by Loupe and Red Team, and fixing it restores proper reconsiderable status and package retry logic for 1p1c and multi-transaction packages under mempool pressure.
